import { Controller, Get, Injectable } from '@nestjs/common';
import axiosDefault, { axios as namedAxios, type AxiosInstance } from 'axios';
import { fetch as undiciFetch } from 'undici';

const HEALTH_URL = 'https://status.example/health?mode=full&token=do-not-store';
const apiClient = axiosDefault.create({ baseURL: 'https://api.example/v1/' });
declare const runtimeBase: string;
const dynamicBaseClient = axiosDefault.create({ baseURL: runtimeBase });
const spreadOptions = { method: 'POST' };

const localAxios = {
  get(_url: string): Promise<unknown> {
    return Promise.resolve(undefined);
  },
};

@Injectable()
export class DownstreamService {
  send(): void {
    axiosDefault.get('https://downstream.example/path');
  }
}

@Injectable()
export class GatewayService {
  constructor(private readonly downstream: DownstreamService) {}

  private readonly propertyClient = axiosDefault.create({
    baseURL: `https://tenant.example/${'acme'}`,
  });

  direct(id: string): void {
    axiosDefault.get(HEALTH_URL);
    namedAxios.post(
      `https://users.example/users/${id}?view=full&authorization=do-not-store#private`,
      { privateCustomerValue: 'body-must-not-appear' },
      { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer header-must-not-appear' } },
    );
    axiosDefault({
      url: 'https://username:password@config.example/request?apiKey=do-not-store#fragment',
      method: 'patch',
      headers: { 'X-Custom': 'header-body-must-not-appear' },
    });
    axiosDefault.request({
      url: '/relative?expand=owner',
      baseURL: 'https://override.example/api',
      method: 'DELETE',
      params: { locale: 'en', page: 1 },
    });
    fetch('https://global.example/items?cursor=do-not-store', {
      headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer global-secret' },
    });
    undiciFetch(`https://undici.example/items/${id}`, { method: 'PUT' });
  }

  instance(): void {
    apiClient.put('/orders/42?expand=items', { privateOrder: 'body-secret' });
    this.propertyClient.head('/ready');
  }

  dynamic(url: string, method: string): void {
    axiosDefault.request({ url, method });
    fetch(url, { method });
    dynamicBaseClient.get('/relative');
  }

  spreadConfig(url: string): void {
    axiosDefault.request({ ...spreadOptions, url });
  }

  unresolved(client: AxiosInstance): void {
    client.get('https://unresolved.example/path');
  }

  computed(method: 'get'): void {
    axiosDefault[method]('https://computed.example/path');
  }

  shadowed(fetch: (url: string) => unknown): void {
    fetch('https://shadowed.example/path');
    localAxios.get('https://lookalike.example/path');
  }

  unused(): void {
    axiosDefault.get('https://unused.example/path');
  }

  deep(): void {
    this.downstream.send();
  }
}

@Controller('gateway')
export class GatewayController {
  constructor(private readonly gateway: GatewayService) {}

  @Get('direct')
  direct(): void {
    this.gateway.direct('42');
  }

  @Get('instance')
  instance(): void {
    this.gateway.instance();
  }

  @Get('deep')
  deep(): void {
    this.gateway.deep();
  }
}
